chapter_title: Data Operations — Tokenizers, Shards, Lineage, PII
course_outline_concepts: Tokenizer construction at scale: BPE/WordPiece/SentencePiece training, vocab-size choice, merges over code vs natural text
Shard and streaming layout: Mosaic streaming, WebDataset, tar / parquet choices; read-throughput vs seek cost
Dataset lineage and versioning: content-addressed hashing, doc-id tracking across filter stages, reproducing a mix months later
Code-repo filtering and executable screening: repo-level license checks, line-length heuristics, executability screens, secret detection
PII and secrets removal as operations (not policy): regex + classifier cascade, opt-out registries, audit log for removal events
Tokenizer extension pitfalls: adding special tokens (<think>, <tool_call>, reasoning tags) post-pretraining without embedding drift

sources.what_to_extract: Six-stage filter cascade with PII as an explicit operational stage (email / IP / phone regex); per-document attribute files as the lineage substrate; ablation of filter order.
Shard and streaming engineering for 15T tokens across 96 CC dumps; per-dump vs global MinHash; datatrove codebase; classifier-score threshold as a lineage-tracked attribute.
Hash-based dedup and the three-stage skeleton that later pipelines inherited; multilingual detail. The ancestor of every content-addressing argument in this chapter.
128K tokenizer sizing; 15.6T-token pretraining shard layout at Meta scale; code-filtering operations (code-exec-filtered code); Llama Guard 3 as a downstream PII/safety consumer.
Tokenizer extension and chat-template adaptation when applying Tulu 3 to a non-Llama base; the two-stage pretraining split (Stage 1 + Dolmino cooldown) creates two tokenizer-consumer checkpoints.
Model-flow worldview: Dolma 3 / Dolma 3 Mix / Dolmino / Longmino / Dolci as separately-tracked lineages, each with its own filter/tokenizer gate. OLMES + OlmoTrace + decontamination tooling.
Multilingual tokenizer covering 119 languages at 36T tokens; instance-level mix assembly as a lineage problem.
Chinese-English tokenizer design implications; FP8 training makes shard-layout throughput decisive; 14.8T pretraining tokens.
Textbook-style synthetic-heavy data; tokenizer has to carry structural tokens for reasoning traces (<think>) and 50 synthetic-category separators — a canonical tokenizer-extension case.
Knowledge capacity scales linearly with parameters; vocab size eats into usable parameter budget — the tokenizer-capacity tradeoff in section 1.
